name: boggart

attributes.attribute: causes destruction and tosses things about the house
becomes a boggart when mistreated by its family

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The boggart is a trickster being. It is a version of the brownie. It appears often in Cornwall. People find it hard to tell from the bogies. The barguest is a close kin. A brownie can become a boggart. This change happens when the family mistreats it. The boggart causes destruction. It tosses things about the house on a whim. Its name comes from the boge syllable. That syllable appears in many sprite names. It carries the sense of a meddling spirit.

okr.objective: Describe the boggart as the malicious trickster form of the brownie.
key_results: The boggart is a trickster version of the brownie found in Cornwall.
